modes.FREE_WRITE: The engine writes each email itself.
modes.TEMPLATE_ONLY: Only approved templates, filled with each person's details.

email.emptyState: No email templates yet. Generate a few from this engine's brief.

whatsapp.replacesNote: New version of an approved template; it replaces that one once Meta approves it.

confirm.withdrawText: The engine stops using it. You can ask the AI for new options any time.
confirm.archiveText: The engine stops using it. You can generate new ones any time.
